description: React component for listing, editing, deleting, and printing product information in an admin interface.

methods.name: fetchList
methods.description: Fetches the list of products from the backend API and updates state.

methods.name: removeProduct
methods.description: Deletes a product by ID via API and refreshes the list.

methods.name: changeProduct
methods.description: Updates local state for product fields based on user input.

methods.name: updateProduct
methods.description: Sends updated product data to backend API and refreshes list.

methods.name: handlePrint
methods.description: Generates a printable HTML table of products and triggers print dialog.
